senses.gloss:
निज् €3 U. (नेनेक्ति, नेनिंक्ते, प्रणेनेक्ति, निक्त)
—1 To wash, cleanse, purify; सस्नुः पयः पपुरनेनिजुरम्बराणि Śi. 5. 28.
—2 To wash or clean oneself, to be purified (Ā.).
—3 To nourish. ━With {@निस्@} to wash, clean, purify; तोयनिर्णिक्तपाणयः
 R. 17. 22; Y. 1. 191; Ms. 5. 127.

निज a. [नितरां जायते निजन्-ड]
—1 Innate, indigenous, native, inborn, congenial.
—2 Own, oneʼs own, relating to one-self, of oneʼs own party or country;
 निजं वपुः पुनरनयन्निजां रुचिम् Śi. 17. 4; R. 3. 15, 18. 27; Ms. 2. 50.
—3 Peculiar.
—4 Continual, perpetual. ━m. (pl.) Oneʼs own people.
.━{@Comp.@}: निजबोधः

निज + -बोधः Self-knowledge, spiritual knowledge; भिक्षुर्न चाहं निजबोधरूपः
 Hastāmalaka Stotra.
